versions.changelog:
- Initial release of GoCreative Crypto.
- Provides live crypto & DeFi market data: spot prices, DEX liquidity, protocol TVL, gas, Fear & Greed sentiment, trending, and stablecoin data.
- Accessible via simple HTTPS calls with no API key or signup.
- Micro-payments: just $0.01 per call with auto-payment via OpenClaw wallet.
- Designed for AI agents needing live crypto/web3 data for trading, research, or treasury decisions.
